reasons: CS4211 is only offered in Sem 1, but its prerequisite CS2103 requires CS2030/CS2040 which require CS1010. CS1010 must be taken in Sem 1. Thus CS2103 cannot be taken in Sem 1, so CS4211 cannot be taken in Sem 1. CS4211 cannot be taken in any later semester because it is not offered.

CS4234 is only offered in Sem 1, but its prerequisite CS3230 requires CS2040/CS1231 which require CS1010. CS1010 is taken in Sem 1. CS2040/CS1231 can be taken in Sem 1 alongside CS1010? No, CS2040 requires CS1010. If CS1010 is in Sem 1, CS2040 can be in Sem 1? No, prerequisite must be completed or planned in strictly earlier semester. So CS2040 must be Sem 2 or later. Thus CS3230 must be Sem 3 or later. Thus CS4234 cannot be taken in Sem 1. Since CS4234 is only offered in Sem 1, it cannot be taken at all.
